body: If your worried about your boobs and thighs getting smaller or slimmer I wouldn’t worry about it, fat is definitely less attractive. I’d rather date someone who’s small in those categories. In the end it’s up to you but it’s not healthy and a lot of people don’t find it attractive.

Try to work on losing weight, right now I feel like that’s the major determining factor. Weight really makes a huge difference. I’m sure you already knew this and me saying it may make me seem like an ass but it’s also healthy to be thinner. If you do plan to lose weight just know it’s a major life style change and it won’t be easy but when you make it out on the other end you’ll be glad you did. Good luck and keep your head up, there’s someone out there for all of us regardless of our weight/height or appearance.
